features: DLavie Assistant is presented to users as a clearer DLavie Support live-help experience
chat header now clearly distinguishes instant support, waiting for admin, and human admin connected states
AI chat includes a direct Hubungi admin action so users do not need to know a special phrase to request human support
human handoff keeps the existing transcript and explains that users may close and reopen the support panel while waiting
mobile live support uses a full-screen chat layout with safe-area handling and a denser conversation view
Human Support Console v34 adds queue summary, waiting/claimed/high-priority filters, search, priority sorting and relative activity age
admin threads now include quick replies, context labels, automatic scroll to latest messages, message length counter and keyboard send shortcut
mobile admin support switches between a full queue view and a full conversation view instead of stacking both panels
note: v34 focuses on the complete user-to-human live support experience while preserving the existing DLavie AI-to-admin handoff backend.
